text: Invest in the HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Plan Mutual Fund | HDFC Mutual Fund Home > Mutual Funds > Equity Mutual Funds > Mid Cap Fund HDFC Mid Cap Fund Equity DIRECT REGULAR About HDFC Mid Cap Fund An open ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks. The Scheme shall follow a predominantly Mid cap strategy with a minimum exposure of 65% to Mid-Cap stocks. The Scheme may also seek participation in other equity and equity related securities to achieve optimal portfolio construction. The aim of equity strategy will be to predominantly build a portfolio of mid-cap companies which have: a) reasonable growth prospects b) sound financial strength c) sustainable business models d) acceptable valuation that offers potential for capital appreciation. text: FAQs Can I invest in SIP and Lump Sum of HDFC Mid Cap Fund ? Yes, SIP as well as Lump Sum investments are permitted with the minimum application amount being ₹100. Any additional purchase must have a minimum amount of ₹100. The SIP and Lumpsum are available in direct and regular plan with both Growth and IDCW option. How to Invest in HDFC Mid Cap Fund ? Investors can apply for their transactions requests either offline or electronically using the relevant application / transaction request forms available on our website or at any of our Officials Points of Acceptance. The application form/transaction slip for subscription/ redemption/ switches can be submitted at our Official Points of Acceptances whose addresses are available on the website of the AMC.
